description: Household electricity demand in Uganda is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley Data. This dataset was prepared to test the hypothesis that modern energy adoption influences household electricity consumption in Uganda, but that this relationship is shaped by structural conditions such as electricity reliability, housing quality, household size, urban/rural residence, regional location, and fuel market exposure. Coverage: Uganda. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley Data. Its tags are Energy Economics. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
